q: With 10 hosts and 50 services, how many integrations does a shared protocol need instead of 500?
Which protocol fits delegating work to an independent agent with its own reasoning and state?
explain: MCP is for tools and data; A2A is for peer agents.

q: When is wrapping a function in an MCP server not worth it?
options: When only your own single application calls it
explain: A protocol pays off with reuse; for one app a plain tool is simpler.
